records.text: Owens said Charlie Kirk vacationed in Maine from July 20 and Michael McCoy and Elizabeth (surname unverified) joined the Kirks for the first time, according to them, capturing footage distributed after Charlie’s assassination.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Then we know on the 20th, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) vacations in Maine for a couple of weeks with his family. He goes off radar. ... Mikey McCoy (Michael McCoy) and Elizabeth (Mikey McCoy's companion; surname unverified) join Erika (Erika Kirk) and Charlie (Charlie Kirk) for the first time, according to them, capturing what's going to be the final footage that is immediately distributed following Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s assassination.
